items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: KLON and they brought Rob Pronk into conduct three or four things with me and the rest of his music.

ctx.x: Yeah, that’s right KLON and they brought Rob Pronk into conduct three or four things with me and the rest of his music. And Artie came from Thousand Oaks area, with a friend drove down to hear me play and we got kind of friendly then.
How amazing, and did he just come up after the concert and say…
